intro: This is the story behind the product in your hand, recorded by Provenance together with the producer.
The full story is being written and will appear on this page. It is a story and nothing more. This page makes no claim of batch verification, laboratory testing or certification.

collection.heading: The Provenance Collection
text: The Provenance Collection is a series of one-off, limited-run releases, made with producers already on the Provenance Map. Provenance works with the producer and does not make its own products.
